justification: The only overlap is generic: both surfaces include highly schematic anthropomorphic forms and some circular/disc motifs with bands of repeated linear marks, features almost any tradition could produce. A depicts a scene dominated by long crewed boats with rows of stroke-crew and tiny stick figures spread across a flat surface, whereas B is a single monumental frontal humanoid body with a blocky head, arms folded over the torso and relief discs and girdle bands on the body — no boats, no narrative multi-figure scene, and a wholly different, volumetric rather than linear-outline manner of depiction.
